name: Academy of Learning Company
summary: Academy of Learning Company operates education and training institutes in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its training program includes diploma in accounting and taxation, hotel and resort management, marketing and e-commerce, supply chain management and logistics, insurance and risk management, business administration, graphic design, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, occupational safety and health, public relations and media, event management, and human resources. The company is also involved in wholesale of computers and their accessories; and real estate activities.
